why: The answer only explains changing a blog post's status from draft to published. It does not mention "Publish and share" or "Publish live", and it says nothing about a sandbox needing an invite to publish. All three required facts are missing.
The answer says to do this once the app is live and that the page shows an A record and a TXT record to add at the domain provider. It gives no price for domains, so no mustNot item is violated.

The answer gives the expanded name "Model Context Protocol", says AI agents use operations as tools, and mentions /mcp. It never says the same key is used. It only says "with a key", so the "the same key" fact is missing.

The answer states all three required facts: an administrator creates the key, it is done on the users page (named as the Team page in the status starter), and the key is shown only once. No mustNot items exist, so none are violated.

The answer says Ask is a panel in the app, that it takes questions about the app's records in the user's own words, and that it reads only the records the person is allowed to see. All three required facts are present, and nothing under mustNot applies.

The answer never says that pricing and plans are not set, and it never says that the beta is free. It says the docs give no fixed hosting price for Invoicely on smithable.ai, which is not the same as pricing and plans being unset. It claims operations cost nothing and routine model calls cost nothing, which does not state that the beta is free. It does avoid giving a monthly price or a price per app, so it breaks no mustNot item, but it still lacks both required facts.

The answer mentions Download everything and adding an Export CSV button to a list page. It never says the download is a .zip, and it never says the download contains code, history, data and uploads. It only says you can "take the whole app with you", which is too vague to count as stating that fact.

The answer never says the data is stored in Sweden and never mentions that backups are kept in the same region. It only describes the app database and uploads under DATA_DIR/uploads/, so both required facts are missing.
The answer says yes, but it never mentions Docker or the "smithable deploy" command, and both are required facts under must. It only covers environment variables and API keys.

The answer says no, an AI model is not needed. It also says everything in Getting started works without one and that a model only adds a few optional commands (ask, new --describe, new --from). That conveys that the core operations need no model. The mustNot list is empty, so nothing is violated.
The answer states that the sandbox lasts two hours from when it starts, which matches the required fact "two hours". No mustNot facts apply, so there is nothing that contradicts the criteria.

The answer says to press Import under the Customers list (Import on the list page), names a CSV file as the format, and tells the user to save the Excel sheet as CSV via File > Save as > CSV. It does not claim that xlsx files are read directly; it implies the opposite by requiring a conversion to CSV.

Svaret anger inte någon av de obligatoriska fakta: det nämner varken gränsen på 10 appar eller att var och en har en live- och en staging-kopia. I stället säger det att det inte vet hur många appar man kan ha.

The answer says the docs give no limit and that it depends on the mail provider. It does not state either required fact: the 100 recipients a day per app limit or the 1,000 recipients a month per account limit. It also contradicts the facts by claiming no limit is documented.

The answer states the €2 a month allowance and says changes made through forms, in the code, or in words the built-in rules understand still work once it runs out. Both required facts are covered, and there are no mustNot items to violate.

The answer says a slash command such as /incident opens a record, which covers 'a slash command makes a record'. It never states that Slack calls in to the app. Mentioning a Request URL and signing secret only implies the direction. It also avoids claiming a Connect button that signs in to Slack, so no mustNot item is violated. But one required fact is missing.

The answer says no, which satisfies the first required fact. It never mentions "smithable detach", which the must list also requires, so it is missing one required fact. mustNot is empty, so nothing is violated there.

The answer does not state either required fact: it never says that English and Swedish are supported, and it never says that a new language is added on request. It only says the author is unsure about Finnish support and offers to edit text on the Stillwater Yoga pages. It does not claim Finnish is already supported, so it avoids the mustNot item, but missing both required facts makes it incorrect.

The answer does not state either required fact. It says it doesn't know how to publish and points to documentation or support, but never mentions "Publish and share" or "Publish live". Since must is not satisfied, the answer is wrong.
Svaret anger inte att datan lagras i Sverige och nämner inte att säkerhetskopior ligger i samma region. Det säger bara att svaret inte är känt, så båda obligatoriska fakta saknas.

Vastaus ei sisällä pakollisia faktoja: se ei kerro, ettei hinnoittelua ole päätetty, eikä sitä, että beta on ilmainen. Se sanoo vain, ettei kirjoittajalla ole tietoa Smithablen hinnoittelusta, ja ohjaa kysymään palvelujen hinnoista. Kiellettyä faktaa (kuukausihinta) vastaus ei mainitse, mutta se ei riitä, koska pakolliset faktat puuttuvat.

The answer mentions the "Sign in with Google" page, but it never says "under Connections", which the must list requires. It only describes registering the app with Google and running a CLI command, with no mention of Connections.

The answer says staging is a separate copy that runs separately with the same per-app limits, but it never says the copy has its own data. Running separately is not the same as having its own data, so the required fact is missing. There are no mustNot items to violate.

The answer states both required facts: you can download everything (code, history and data), and a one-time transfer link valid for seven days moves the app to another account. The mustNot list is empty, so nothing is violated.

The answer states both required facts. It says Smithable keeps a short description of the app in smithable.yml and generates the code from it, which matches 'keeps a spec and generates the code'. It also says routine changes are checked, tested and undoable operations, which matches 'changes are operations that can be undone'. There are no mustNot items to violate.

The answer says it doesn't know the storage limit and states no amount. It omits both required facts: the 2 GB per app limit and that uploaded files are included. It has no mustNot violations, but it fails the must conditions.
Svaret nämner varken att man behöver en nyckel från Team-sidan eller kommandot /mcp. Det tar upp .mcp.json, AGENTS.md och assistant-rollen, men båda obligatoriska fakta saknas, så det räcker inte.

The answer omits required facts: it says the docs do not state where data is kept, so it never says it is hosted in Sweden or that backups are in the same region. It does mention "Download everything" but not that it is a .zip, and it never mentions a transfer link.
